source_record.title: Web Developer (m/f/d)
source_record.description:
Your Mission

  • Lead the architecture design, development, and performance optimization of our company’s core web products, ensuring high-quality delivery.

  • Design technical solutions for complex functional modules, including data visualization dashboards, editors, and real-time communication features.

  • Tackle key challenges such as cross-browser compatibility, performance bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities to optimize user experience.

  • Drive front-end engineering initiatives, including CI/CD pipelines, component libraries, and micro-frontend infrastructure.

  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and backend teams—participating in requirements reviews and providing technical feasibility assessments.

 

Your Profile

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field with 5+ years of web development experience.

  • Fluent in English; understanding of Chinese is a strong plus.

  • In-depth knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and proficiency with ES6+ features and design patterns.

  • Skilled in front-end build and release tools; hands-on experience with Vite or Webpack.

  • Proficient in at least one modern front-end framework (Vue or React), with a solid grasp of its core principles and hands-on project experience.

  • Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS and other network protocols; familiarity with backend technology stacks, Node.js, and front-end/back-end separation principles.

  • Expertise in front-end performance optimization strategies and experience using performance analysis tools.

  • Preferred: background in componentization, engineering, or deep technical research.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, passion for new Internet technologies, and eagerness to explore industry trends.

  • Proactive, with excellent communication and teamwork abilities, and a commitment to delivering outstanding user experiences.

 

Bonus Points:

  • Practical experience with 3D development.

  • Hands-on experience in front-end security measures (XSS, CSRF, CSP).

  • Active contributors to GitHub, technical blogs, or open-source projects.

 

Why Join Us?

  • Shape the future of renewable energy at the crossroads of technology and sustainability.

  • Collaborate with a global, diverse, and innovative team.

  • Thrive in a flat, fast-paced, and empowering culture.

  • Gain the unique opportunity to influence and drive meaningful, sustainable change.

 

Ready to help power a greener future? We look forward to receiving your application!
